answer.justification: Only logit-level data is available. Top-1 agreement is 0.865 and sequence agreement is 0.344, both in the system-prompted range (0.861-0.908 and 0.31-0.48), below fine-tuned (0.900-0.938) and quantized (0.945-0.955). KL is 0.429, above even the system-prompted range (0.197-0.339), and far above fine-tuned (up to 0.205). TV is 0.146 and Token-DiFR gap is 0.529, both at or just above the top of the system-prompted range (0.144 and 0.52), so the change is large. Raw-score shift÷TV is 3.7, within the system-prompted range (3.3-3.9). Fine-tuned could produce a large shift, but the combined size of the divergence fits system-prompted better. Base and quantized are ruled out because their differences are zero or small.
